Title: Information on: Why can't Christians transform into animals at wil...
The ability for humans to transform into animals, as depicted in certain mythologies and folklore, is not supported by Christian doctrine. Christianity primarily focuses on spiritual transformation through faith, repentance, and the indwelling of the Holy Spirit, rather than physical metamorphosis into animal forms.
